slides.headline: Month-end money admin: 20 minutes, not a weekend.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: It has account numbers and names you don't need to share.
slides.right:
Clean it first,
share only the list.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Gather the numbers
slides.card: Here is this month's income and expenses: [paste]. Tell me what looks missing or odd.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Sort your expenses
slides.card: Sort these into: software, travel, marketing, other. Show a total per category.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Hidden subscriptions
slides.card: List every repeating charge. Flag any I might not use and show the yearly cost of each.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Chase unpaid invoices
slides.card: Here are my unpaid invoices: [paste]. Draft a short, friendly reminder for each, oldest first.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Write the summary
slides.card: Write a 5-line summary of this month: income, biggest costs, what changed, what to do next.
slides.note: Check every number. Tax questions: ask a pro.

scenes.headline: You wrote the perfect prompt once.

scenes.label: THE PROBLEM
scenes.wrong: Scrolling old chats to find it

scenes.title: Build your library
items: Add one line: when to use

scenes.title: EXAMPLE ENTRY
scenes.label: SAVE LIKE THIS
scenes.text:
Name: Customer reply
Use when: a client asks for a quote

Draft a reply to [email]. Tone: [friendly]. Keep it under [100] words. Ask me if anything is unclear.
Save this and build yours today.
scenes.note: Keep private data out of saved prompts.
